Subject : Establishments Complying as Exempted Establishments as per ECR,
Verification thereof — Regarding.

Sir/Madam,

In line with the e-governance policy of the Government, filing of online returns by
exempted/relaxed establishments enjoying exemption from the operation of the EPF Scheme,
1952 and maintaining their own private P. F. Trusts, was implemented by EPFO in March, 2014.
Subsequent to implementation of filing of online returns, a Dashboard of exempted
establishments was also developed and put in place to facilitate effective monitoring of this
category of establishments at the level of field offices.

2 Regional P. F. Commissioners In-charge of the field offices were expected to check and
verify the basic details furnished by the exempted/relaxed establishments and their Trusts
through Part — ‘A’ and Part — ‘B’ of online returns with physical records available with the office
or the establishments and get the inconsistencies removed/rectified. However, it is noted that
due attention has not been paid by the Regional P. F. Commissioners In-charge of the field
offices to this task. As a consequence, apparent inconsistencies are observed in the information
available on the Dashboard of exempted establishments with respect to exempted/relaxed
establishments of all the field offices so far as basic details, such as name and addresses of the
establishment, name and addresses of the Trust, PAN number of establishments and Trusts,
Notification number, Relaxation Order number, etc. are concerned.

3 Further, the Dashboard reveals that out of 1550 exempted establishments, status of
large number of them is shown as ‘relaxed’ ones. Three types of situation may obtain in respect
of such ‘relaxed’ establishments :-

Situation-I : Relaxation order has been granted in favour of the establishment and
proposal for grant of exemption is pending either with EPFO or with the
appropriate Governments.

Situation - II : Relaxation order granted in favour of the establishment has since been
withdrawn by the Regional P. F. Commissioner concerned but the
establishment has moved High Court and has obtained stay order against the
order of the Regional P. F. Commissioner.

Situation — III: Relaxation order has been granted in favour of the establishment, but
proposal for grant of exemption has not been processed further and
forwarded to Head Office till date.

Situation - IV : Details furnished by the establishments through Part — ‘A’ of online returns is
erroneous with respect to its notified/relaxed status and hence, reflection on
the Dashboard as ‘relaxed’ is erroneous.

In case of situation - III, field offices are required to review such pending cases and forward
proposals for grant of exemption to the Head Office in deserving cases with explanation for
inordinate delay. In case of situation - IV, field offices are required to take corrective steps. A
summary report of establishments reflected as ‘relaxed’ may be furnished to the Head Office.

4. Furthermore, as per statistics available on the Dashboard as on date, there are 1550
establishments reflected as exempted/relaxed ones. Besides, there are 1441 establishments
reflected as branches of such exempted/relaxed establishments having separate code number.
Taking both the figures together, there are 2991 establishments reflected as exempted/relaxed
establishments. But, the number of establishments reported to be complying as exempted
establishments as per ECR is 3360, which is apparently inconsistent with the figure of
establishments reflected as exempted/relaxed establishments and calls for taking urgent
corrective/compliance action on the part of the Regional P. F. Commissioners In-charge of the
field offices, so as to remove inconsistency and bring it in line with the actual figures. A
summary report (furnishing details such as name, code number and action taken) of such
weeded out establishments may be furnished to the Head Office.

5. Compliance and monitoring of exempted establishments lies in the original jurisdiction of
Regional P. F. Commissioners/OICs of the field offices. Therefore, RPFCs are requested to
accord due priority to the above mentioned tasks and get the exercise completed by
31.12.2016. An action taken report in this regard may please be forwarded to the Head Office
through Addl. Central P. F. Commissioner(Zones) latest by 07.01.2017 through e-mail only to
acc.exemption@epfindia.gov.in and rc.exemption@epfindia.gov.in.

[This issues with the approval of Central P. F. Commissioner]

Yours faithfully,

KU od
